name: Sovremennyj Sovjonok: END OF SKY
source: Modification-continuation of the plot of the series "Modern Owl". The action unfolds by lowering the time after the events of "Change or Die", showing you a new world in which the " Owl " has become not a mystical place somewhere in the fog, but a very ordinary camp. With its own history, secrets and riddles.
